items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta/full launch; keep private. Evidence: Woot API documentation confirms access mechanics but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict commercial/public product-data use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, compliance, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Recommendation: leave rights outreach unsent pending human counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering the rights matrix, data flow/retention, deployed consent and GA4 settings, logs/vendors, and incident/request procedures.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks evidenced to closure; no task is closed. Source-rights evidence is blocked, data-flow and consent evidence are partial, and logs/vendor/incident evidence remains open. Next evidence action is one consolidated dated read-only bundle from repository, deployed configuration, GA4 settings, vendor records, and incident/request procedures. Do not expose upstream data, enable new tracking, add affiliate/advertising use, or send rights outreach.

Fleet compliance is a technical risk baseline, not certification: 35 sites pass, 20 fail, and 6 are unknown. Ordinary reversible growth need not stop solely because telemetry is incomplete, but no new data collection, public data product, monetization expansion, regulated or age-sensitive flow, or security-sensitive release should be cleared without applicable evidence and human review. Revenue remains bounded to 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; do not assign it to sites or claim ROI, margin, or causal lift.
